source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
While this model leads a unit, that unit's models get **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)**, and:

- whenever one of them makes a **[Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)**, **[Fall Back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** or **[Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)**, that model can pass horizontally over models and terrain features
- during a **[Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or **[Fall Back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**, they can enter [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of an enemy model but cannot finish the move there, and they pass any [Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape) automatically
